import numpy as np
import json

r2 = np.load('/work/fwd/r2/run.npz')
l0_mlp = r2['L0_MLP']

tokens0 = ["BOS", "V", "LB", "TPSI", "b", "no", "J", "oCLrZaW", "poiVg", "LB"]
lengths0 = [3, 1, 2, 4, 1, 2, 1, 7, 5, 2]

print("Normalized L0_MLP write directions (input 0):")
odd_dirs, even_dirs = [], []
for pos, (tok, l) in enumerate(zip(tokens0, lengths0)):
    w = l0_mlp[0, pos, :]
    norm = np.linalg.norm(w)
    d = w / (norm + 1e-8)
    p = "ODD" if l%2==1 else "EVEN"
    print(f"  {tok:12s}({p}, mag={norm:.3f}): dir={d.round(4)}")
    if l%2==1: odd_dirs.append(d)
    else: even_dirs.append(d)

odd_dirs = np.stack(odd_dirs)
even_dirs = np.stack(even_dirs)
print(f"\nOdd direction std:  {odd_dirs.std(0).round(4)}")
print(f"Even direction std: {even_dirs.std(0).round(4)}")
print(f"Odd mean dir:  {odd_dirs.mean(0).round(4)}")
print(f"Even mean dir: {even_dirs.mean(0).round(4)}")
print(f"Cosine sim within odd: {np.min([np.dot(odd_dirs[i], odd_dirs[j]) for i in range(len(odd_dirs)) for j in range(i+1, len(odd_dirs))]):.4f}")
print(f"Cosine sim within even: {np.min([np.dot(even_dirs[i], even_dirs[j]) for i in range(len(even_dirs)) for j in range(i+1, len(even_dirs))]):.4f}")
print(f"Cosine sim odd vs even: {np.max([np.dot(odd_dirs[i], even_dirs[j]) for i in range(len(odd_dirs)) for j in range(len(even_dirs))]):.4f}")

# Decision
odd_within = odd_dirs.std(0).max()
even_within = even_dirs.std(0).max()
print(f"\nMax within-direction std: odd={odd_within:.4f}, even={even_within:.4f}")
binary_direction = odd_within < 0.05 and even_within < 0.05
print(f"Binary directional signal? {binary_direction}")
print(f"=> Tag: {'INDICATOR (binary direction)' if binary_direction else 'MAPPER (non-binary, varies by token)'}")
